units.title: All About Frogs
units.description: Learning what frogs are and how they live.
steps: Observe that frogs live both in water and on land.
Identify how frogs move (jumping) and the sound they make (croaking).
Understand that frogs have smooth, often wet skin.

units.title: Using Describing Words
units.description: Learning words to describe an animal's appearance and actions.
steps: Practice describing a frog: 'The frog is green and it jumps high.'
Differentiate between how an animal looks and what it does.
